digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, 'चीन का दलाल' बनी पाकिस्तान की नई पहचान, नहीं रही अपनी कोई औकात, अमेरिका ने भी माना मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president in Myanmar after Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. articles.title: El Niño forecast to intensify, increasing likelihood of extreme weather

articles.title: Who's Shipping Bananas To Russia, And Who's Shipping Cocaine?
articles.summary: A Systema investigation found that banana shipments to St. Petersburg sometimes conceal cocaine. articles.title: Culture war killing America’s response to demographic decline
articles.summary: The Supreme Court affirmed birthright citizenship under the 14th Amendment. Birthright citizenship is the law of the land.
